race.comment: APOSTLE (1) is favoured off a sharply improved second at Toowoomba, where he warmed nicely late to only miss by a long neck. Gets his first look at the 1500m but his splits suggest he will relish it. WIN STAR (5) dug deep to fend off a challenger and justify the short quote, with a big gap back to the rest. Draws the A1 and gets a good chance to go on with it. MURKADO (2) has been close up in both runs this campaign and had a check last start at the Gold Coast. Drawn kinder this time, so if he takes closer order he may prove hard to hold out late. EMBER ROYALE (6) was a last-start maiden winner at the Sunny Coast. Suspect she can play a role late if the pace is genuine.
